# NFSU2 Server control v1.8.1

**New product identity · Dark themed dialogs · Updated preferences · Runtime build fixes**

v1.8.1 renames the Windows application to **NFSU2 Server control** and publishes it as **NFSU2 Server control.exe**. It also improves the update preferences screen, replaces standard Windows message boxes with app-themed dialogs, and fixes two WASM runtime compilation blockers in the companion NFSU2-Web repository.

[Download release](https://github.com/trpolaris/TRPOLARIS-NFSU2-Web-Control-Center/releases/latest) · [Control Center source](https://github.com/trpolaris/TRPOLARIS-NFSU2-Web-Control-Center) · [NFSU2-Web source](https://github.com/trpolaris/NFSU2-Web)

</div>

---

## What's new

### Product name and executable
- Product and window name: **NFSU2 Server control**
- Published executable: `NFSU2 Server control.exe`
- Product metadata, startup screen, update preferences and main window use the new name.
- The updater recognizes the previous `TRPOLARIS.ControlCenter.exe` and `TRPOLARIS.NFSU2.WebControlCenter.exe` names.
- First launch migrates the old executable name without creating `.previous`, `.bak`, or another backup copy.

### Dark themed preferences and dialogs
- ComboBox controls now use a custom dark popup and readable item states instead of the bright Windows default popup.
- Update history uses a matching dark ListBox with hover and selected states.
- The preferences window has a custom title bar matching the Night Circuit design.
- Confirmation, warning and error dialogs use the application's own WPF theme instead of Windows MessageBox windows.

### NFSU2-Web WASM build fixes
- `runtime/mpcredit.c` no longer includes missing `guest.h`, `game.h` or `featurelist.h` files. It uses the shared runtime CPU, guest-memory and dispatch APIs.
- The WASM runtime has its own bounded guest-memory access helpers and main-loop game-call wrapper.
- `runtime/com.c` reads `NFSU2_FSAA` from the runtime environment instead of relying on the unavailable native `setting_bool` parser.

### Existing update safeguards
- Update manifests remain RSA-SHA256 signed and the downloaded executable is checked by exact size and SHA-256.
- The updater continues to replace the application without creating a backup file.
- Since backups are disabled by design, a startup failure after replacement is recorded but cannot automatically restore the previous executable.

## One-time upgrade from v1.8.0 or earlier

The product identity and signed release asset have changed, so older clients cannot consume this release as an in-place update. Close the old application, place the downloaded `NFSU2 Server control.exe` in the existing application folder using the old executable's current filename, and overwrite the old file. Launch it once; v1.8.1 detects either previous executable name and renames itself to `NFSU2 Server control.exe`. Do not create a manual backup if you want to keep the no-backup policy.

## Release assets

- `NFSU2 Server control.exe`
- `update-manifest.json`

The RSA private signing key remains in the GitHub Actions repository secret `UPDATE_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY`; it is not included in the repository or release assets.
